API project | In development

HelpDeskHub

The problem

A help desk needs a structured way to connect support tickets with requesters, assigned staff, departments, comments and ticket history.

My contribution

I built the ASP.NET Core REST API foundation, worked on ticket, department and user endpoints, integrated ASP.NET Identity, and updated database relationships through Entity Framework migrations.

Technologies and approach

C#, ASP.NET Core, PostgreSQL, Entity Framework Core, ASP.NET Identity, DTOs and Swagger for endpoint testing.

What it delivers

The project has a working API foundation and relational data layer that support continued ticket-workflow development.

Current status

An MVC front end, workload-based assignment, notifications and reporting remain on the roadmap. This is a development project, not a completed production service.
